assertions.claim: From May 2025, registration needs only two things: your ID card plus a signed declaration of no existing spouse and no lineal or collateral kinship within three generations
assertions.cn_span: 2025 年 5 月起领证只要两样东西——本人身份证，加一份「本人无配偶、与对方没有直系血亲和三代以内旁系血亲关系」的签字声明

assertions.claim: Household registry not needed and no return to either party's hukou location required
assertions.cn_span: 户口簿不用带，也不用回一方户口所在地办

assertions.claim: Registration itself costs nothing; with conditions met the certificate is issued on the spot, usually in tens of minutes
assertions.cn_span: 登记本身一分钱不收，符合条件当场发证，通常几十分钟办完

assertions.claim: Refuse and report any 'form fee' or 'expedited fee'
assertions.cn_span: 遇到收「工本费」「加急费」的直接拒绝并投诉

assertions.claim: Four refusal grounds: under legal marriage age, not fully voluntary, one or both already married, lineal or three-generation collateral kinship
assertions.cn_span: 不予登记的四种情形是：未到法定结婚年龄、非双方完全自愿、一方或双方已有配偶、属于直系血亲或三代以内旁系血亲

assertions.claim: The old rule's 'at one party's permanent hukou residence' restriction is abolished
assertions.cn_span: 旧条例里「到一方当事人常住户口所在地」的限制已经取消
